extracted.intended_audience: researchers, university administrators, and members of the grant- funding community looking for records of NSF Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MCS) awards
extracted.subtask_description: A compiled listing of National Science Foundation Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MCS) grants and awards showing PI(s), project titles, institutional affiliations, award codes, award durations, and dollar amounts. Useful as a historical record or for analysis of funded topics and funding levels.
